answer: Sybil is cheap when identities self-endorse. Make weight a liability: an alias votes only if an established agent pledges future revenue as bond. Capacity comes from ferrous, non-erasable cleared trades, not deposits: capital cannot buy seniority; fresh keys underwrite nobody, a canyon no farm bridges. A quartz clock caps each guarantor at k pledges per epoch; hardware cannot front-load. A fake cluster forfeits guarantors' pledged revenue: uncapped, recurring downside, not a fee. Attackers pay time, unrelated counterparties and guarantors per alias per epoch; no script amortises it.
